snippet.description:
This video is part of Zoomterview — intimate conversations with Zoom Solopreneur 50 honorees, filmed entirely on Zoom with journalist and entrepreneur Nayeema Raza, host of "Smart Girls, Dumb Questions."

Stefania Marzelia is the founder of Sips, a premium, cafe-quality coffee brand she launched in late 2024. A former barista turned corporate consultant turned solo founder, Stefania shares how she built a $200K organic revenue business in year one, why she pivoted her ICP, and how she stays connected as a one-woman operation.

snippet.title: She Was a Barista at 16. Now She Runs a $200K Coffee Brand Solo
snippet.description:
Stefania Marzelia picked up an apron at 16 and never really let go of what made that job matter: real human connection, delivered through a great experience. But after college, she took the "expected" path, a corporate consulting role she knew by day two wasn't for her. She left, leaned back into what she loved, and built Sips, a premium, cafe-quality instant coffee brand designed for the everyday coffee drinker who wants something elevated without the fuss. In year one, Sips brought in $200K in completely organic revenue. Not bad for a one-woman operation.

What you'll learn:
• How Stefania went from barista at 16 to solo founder in her 20s
• Why she pivoted her ICP away from coffee enthusiasts and toward casual drinkers
• How she built $200K in revenue with zero paid advertising
• Her honest take on why solopreneurship can feel lonely and how events and community fix it
• Why she believes every business owner in 2026 has to be a content creator
• How she's building operational systems in 2026 to scale without burning out

FAQ: Can you build a sustainable product business without social media in 2026?
According to Stefania, probably not. She says that being a business owner in 2026 is synonymous with being a content creator. Afterall if you're not putting yourself out there, who is? She argues consumers need an emotional connection to the brands they buy from; a good product alone isn't enough anymore.

snippet.title: Can You Really Train a Cat? This Solopreneur Has Done It 1,053 Times
snippet.description:
This video is part of the Zoomterview series — intimate conversations with Zoom Solopreneur 50 honorees. In each episode, journalist and entrepreneur Nayeema Raza, host of "Smart Girls, Dumb Questions," sits down with an honoree to unpack the mindset, tools, and grit behind running a thriving solo operation.

Joey Lusvardi is an IAABC-certified cat behavior consultant and founder of Class Act Cats. With a background in psychology, he's translated human behavioral science into a global cat training practice — run entirely solo, entirely on Zoom.

In this conversation, Nayeema covers:

Why cat conflict is the #1 issue he's called in to fix (and why he calls it "feline couples therapy")

How going virtual made his consultations more effective, not less

How he's worked with cats on 4+ continents — including one bicoastal jet-setter

Why credentials matter in an industry where people still doubt that cat training is real

FAQ: Can cats actually be trained?

Yes — and the science backs it up. Joey uses the same core learning principles applied in human psychology, adapted for feline behavior. With the right approach, cats can be trained to reduce aggression, ease multi-cat conflict, and change problem behaviors.

snippet.title: He's Trained 1,053 Cats — and Does It All on Zoom | Zoom Solopreneur 50 Honoree Class Act Cats
snippet.description:
Joey Lusvardi didn't stumble into cat training. He came in through the side door — a psychology degree, a deep understanding of behavioral science, and a realization that the same principles governing how humans learn and respond to their environment apply just as powerfully to cats. That foundation became Class Act Cats: a solo practice, IAABC-certified, operating entirely over Zoom, with clients on at least four continents.

His specialty? Cat conflict. Think: two cats who can't share a space, a kitten terrorizing a senior cat, or a newly introduced housemate creating chaos. Joey calls it "marriage and family therapy, feline edition" — and he's very, very good at it.

What you'll learn:
• Why Joey traded in-person sessions for virtual — and why cats actually behave better on camera
• The #1 behavioral problem in multi-cat households (and what's really causing it)
• How psychology and animal behavior science overlap more than most people think
• What it took to become IAABC-certified — and why credentials matter in a field people still don't take seriously
• How Joey manages a global client base as a true solopreneur, filmed entirely on Zoom
• What it looks like to build a niche business that people doubted — until the results spoke for themselves

FAQ: Is virtual cat behavior consulting actually effective?
According to Joey, it's more effective than in-person. Cats behave naturally in their home environment without a stranger present, which gives him a cleaner read on the actual problem — and a better shot at solving it.

snippet.title: Your Loofah Is 100% Plastic — And It's Making You Sick
snippet.description:
This video is part of the Zoomterview intimate conversations with Zoom Solopreneur 50 honorees, filmed entirely on Zoom with journalist and entrepreneur Nayeema Raza, host of "Smart Girls, Dumb Questions."
Phoebe, founder of Floofah, spent years in the recycling industry watching recyclable materials end up in landfills anyway. So she built a 100% plant-based loofah from a natural gourd — grown by generational farmers in South China — with zero plastic from product to packaging. Did you know most plastic loofahs should be replaced every 6 weeks because bacteria gets trapped in the center? Floofah lasts up to 8 — and actually lets air through.

What makes Floofah different from every other "sustainable" bath product on the market?

snippet.title: From Recycling to a 100% Plant-Based Loofah | Floofah
snippet.description:
What if the answer to plastic shower poufs was growing on a farm? After years in the recycling industry, Floofah founder Phoebe created a 100% plant-based loofah with no plastic in the product, packaging, or materials.

In this Zoomterview, journalist and entrepreneur Nayeema Raza—host of “Smart Girls, Dumb Questions”—speaks with the Zoom Solopreneur 50 honoree about turning recycling expertise into a global, plastic-free product business.

Phoebe explains the truth about “wish cycling,” why recycling infrastructure cannot solve every plastic problem, and how her experience led her to build the alternative she believed the industry needed. She also shares how Floofah sponges are made from natural loofah gourds by generational farmers in South China—and how technology helps her operate an international  company as a solo founder.

You’ll also learn why conventional plastic loofahs can trap bacteria, how often they should be replaced, and what makes a plant-based loofah different. Floofah can be used as a bath or kitchen sponge, dries faster than plastic alternatives, and lasts up to eight weeks.

Watch the conversation to explore sustainable entrepreneurship, plastic-free living, and the realities of building a physical-product business solo. If it gives you a new perspective on everyday plastic, consider sharing it with someone rethinking their routine.

Learn more about the Zoom Solopreneur 50: https://www.zoom.com/en/audiences/solopreneurs/

snippet.title: She Left Recycling to Build a Plastic-Free Loofah | Zoom Solopreneur 50 Honoree Floofah
snippet.description:
Most “recyclable” materials never get recycled—and Phoebe saw the problem firsthand while working in the recycling industry. Her response was to build Floofah, a 100% plant-based, plastic-free loofah designed down to the thread and packaging.

In this Zoomterview, journalist and entrepreneur Nayeema Raza speaks with Zoom Solopreneur 50 honoree Phoebe about creating a sustainable product company from scratch after earning her MBA at Haas. Phoebe explains how Floofah goes from loofah gourd to finished product, working with generational growers in South China and eliminating synthetic materials at every step.

You’ll learn: 
• Why “wish cycling” can’t fix gaps in recycling infrastructure 
• Where plastic hides in everyday bathroom and kitchen products 
• How natural loofah gourds become plant-based shower and kitchen scrubbers 
• How Floofah compares with plastic loofahs that need frequent replacement 
• How Phoebe uses technology, including Zoom, to manage global supplier relationships 
• Why she chose solopreneurship over a traditional corporate career
Floofah can be used on skin and kitchen surfaces, including nonstick and cast iron, without synthetic additives.

Discover more intimate conversations with the Zoom Solopreneur 50 honorees—and explore all 50 founders: https://www.zoom.com/en/audiences/solopreneurs/

snippet.title: How a One-Person Newsroom Is Reviving Local Journalism | Zoom Solopreneur 50 Honoree
snippet.description:
Can one person run an entire local newsroom—and rebuild community trust in the process? Meet Branden Andersen, founder of Newsberg, a hyperlocal media company serving Newberg, Oregon, and neighboring Dundee.

Branden launched Newsberg from a hospital birthing suite and turned it into a full-time career. Today, he publishes 6–8 original stories each week while handling nearly every role himself: reporter, editor, CEO, and advertising salesperson.

In this Zoomterview, journalist and entrepreneur Nayeema Raza, host of “Smart Girl, Dumb Questions,” talks with Branden about the future of local journalism and the realities of building an independent media business.

You’ll learn: 
• Why local journalism isn’t dying—it’s taking a new shape 
• How a lean technology stack helps one person operate a newsroom 
• What it takes to balance reporting, editing, leadership, and ad sales 
• Why Newsberg is bringing print back—and why readers want it 
• How hyperlocal reporting can strengthen community trust

Zoomterviews features intimate conversations with Zoom Solopreneur 50 honorees who are building remarkable businesses on their own terms.

snippet.title: She made $200,000 from home | Zoom Solopreneur 50 Honoree Ambra X Nayeema Raza
snippet.description:
As part of Zoom's collaboration with journalist and entrepreneur, Nayeema Raza, host of podcast "Smart Girl Dumb Questions", Zoomterviews features candid conversations with members of the Zoom Solopreneur 50 – entrepreneurs defining what it means to build a successful business on their own.   

In this conversation, Nayeema sits down with Ambra Jordan, founder of Rebellious Pins, to explore what it really takes to build a bold brand from the ground up. Ambra shares how rebellion, discipline, and community shape her businesses, from creating enamel pins with messages that challenge expectations to building an unapologetically authentic, creative brand. 

She opens up about the realities of running a business of one – including the freedom, resilience, and focus that come with running a business independently. 

In this conversation, you'll learn:

• What "rebellion" means in Ambra's work and entrepreneurial journey
• How she turned creative ideas into a thriving business
• Why she's building her company on her own terms
• How technology helps her build and run a one-person business

Filmed entirely on Zoom, this honest and funny conversation explores self-expression, women in business, creative entrepreneurship, and what it means to build your own path rather than follow someone else’s rules.

Watch the full interview, then explore more Zoom Solopreneur 50 stories celebrating the creators, makers, and independent business owners redefining work for themselves here

snippet.title: Ep. 37 | Zoom AI Productivity Suite: Turn Meetings Into Finished Work
snippet.description:
What if every meeting could become a doc, spreadsheet, deck, or polished summary—without starting from scratch? Zoom AI Productivity Suite helps turn conversations into finished work inside Zoom Workplace.

This video breaks down how Zoom’s AI-first productivity tools connect meeting context to real deliverables. 

Zoom Canvas brings together docs, wikis, tables, meeting recaps, and project briefs so teams can start with the context already captured. 

Zoom Sheets turns messy meeting data, transcripts, or imported files into structured spreadsheets, formulas, charts, and insights. 

Zoom Slides helps transform meetings, docs, and ideas into polished presentations with structure, speaker notes, and brand consistency. 

Zoom Paper supports fast notes, drafts, and client-ready documents without the formatting grind.

The key advantage is connection: after a meeting, notes can flow into Zoom Canvas with My Notes, then feed into Sheets, Slides, or Paper—without exporting, switching tabs, or rebuilding the same work manually.

If your team spends too much time turning meetings into follow-up materials, see how Zoom AI Productivity Suite helps move from conversation to completion.

snippet.title: Zoom Revenue Accelerator: AI Sales Coaching and Pipeline Intelligence
snippet.description:
Learn what Zoom Revenue Accelerator is and how it helps sales teams improve coaching, manage pipeline risk, and increase forecast accuracy with AI-powered revenue orchestration. - *Real-Time Coaching Intelligence:* Scale sales coaching with automated conversation scorecards that evaluate rep performance and surface high-impact coaching opportunities without manual review.
- *Proactive Deal Risk Alerts:* Identify stalled or at-risk deals before they impact the quarter. AI flags potential risk directly within the pipeline based on engagement signals and deal activity.
- *AI Sales Assistant:* Use a conversational interface to ask about pipeline health, rep activity, coaching insights, and revenue predictions, then get instant, actionable answers.
- *Centralized Pipeline Management:* Gain a 360-degree view of the deal timeline by tracking CRM-connected activity across calls, emails, meetings, and SMS, so every next step stays visible.
- *Automated Win Stories:* Turn closed-won deals into shareable summaries that highlight win reasons, key takeaways, and executive-level insights teams can use to replicate success.

snippet.title: How to Automatically Send Certificates to Zoom Webinar Attendees
snippet.description:
Ditch the messy spreadsheets, manual email follow-ups, and tedious post-event tracking! In this tutorial, learn how to use *Certification from Zoom* to automatically reward continuing education (CE/CLE) credits, compliance verification, and custom branded certificates right inside Zoom Webinars Plus and Zoom Events.

0:00 - Introduction: Automated Zoom Certification
0:31 - Setting Completion Criteria & Credit Values
1:04 - Designing Branded Certificate Templates
1:24 - Live Tracking & Instant Certificate Delivery
1:41 - Reviewing Compliance & Certificate Analytics

*What We Cover Inside:*

• *Custom Completion Criteria:* Take control of your educational parameters. Mix and match automated rules like minimum video watch time, mandatory poll participation, or direct content access—such as downloading required training materials before credit is issued.

• *Flexible Credit Distribution:* Tailor your credit weighting systems. Award full attendance credit once all criteria are met or configure automated partial credits (up to 20 total) to accurately compensate attendees based on their real-time session interaction.

• *Drag-and-Drop Template Design:* Match your exact brand identity. Choose to modify Zoom's default layout with your custom logos, typography styles, and corporate colors, or upload an external template. Arrange dynamic variables like individual attendee names, session titles, and exact completion dates on a live preview canvas.

• *Instant Delivery & Live Tracking:* Watch Zoom handle the distribution loop silently in the background. The moment an attendee triggers the required milestone, they receive an immediate on-screen congratulations prompt with a direct download link, backed by automated follow-up email notifications.

• *Granular Compliance Analytics:* Protect your reporting accuracy. Access a dedicated post-event analytics dashboard detailing precisely who qualified for certification, their specific watch-time intervals, exact credits earned, and a breakdown of completed criteria lines.

Learn more: https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0083983

If this compliance and training workflow guide helped you scale your webinar automation, make sure to like the video and subscribe for more enterprise tech tips.

snippet.title: Zoom Virtual Agent Receptionist Onboarding Demo
snippet.description:
Never miss a customer call again with Zoom Virtual Agent, the intelligent AI receptionist that keeps your business connected 24/7. This powerful tool answers calls and engages with customers when your team is unavailable, helping you manage inquiries, book appointments, and ensure every caller reaches the right person.
Setting up your Zoom Virtual Agent is straightforward. Start in AI Studio, create your voice agent, and customize its name, language, greeting, and voice to align with your brand. Easily feed it knowledge by uploading PDFs, website links, or FAQs, making it an expert on your business. From there, set up smart call routing and custom topics, allowing callers to find the information they need or transfer by name to specific team members instantly. Integrate your calendar so customers can book appointments directly during their call, then link it to your Zoom Phone auto-receptionist, and you’re live. 
With Zoom Virtual Agent, you can ensure every call is answered, every customer is helped, and no leads are lost, delivering seamless customer engagement and support.

snippet.title: How to Manage Zoom Webinars and Events Concurrency
snippet.description:
Learn how to manage concurrency for Zoom Events and Zoom Webinars licenses. Concurrency refers to how many Zoom Events or Zoom Webinars can run at the same time under an organization’s license capacity. This video explains how admins can choose between Shared Pool mode and Assigned Licenses mode, align host access with scheduling needs, and reduce overlapping event conflicts.

What You'll Learn: 
• Understanding concurrency basics and how it works 
• Shared Pool mode - automatic license distribution 
• Assigned Licenses mode - manual control and allocation 
• How to prevent event scheduling conflicts 
• Best practices for different organization sizes

snippet.title: Zoom Virtual Agent: Scalable AI Customer Support Tour
snippet.description:
Discover how Zoom Virtual Agent reinvents the customer experience by transitioning from rigid, rules-based phone menus to an intelligent, fluid conversational framework. This overview highlights how our agentic AI foundation understands conversational intent, shifts seamlessly between dialects in real time, and operates independently to resolve end-to-end issues without manual deflection.  

We look into advanced multimodal tools that process physical variables like product damage photos or asset barcodes. Learn how this self-improving loop converts human resolution context into structured automated knowledge, empowering support centers to scale operations while retaining a personal touch.  

0:00 Introduction: The Challenge of Customer Trust
0:17 Built Differently: An AI-First Virtual Agent
0:31 Natural Fluency: Adapting via Accents & Dialects
0:40 Multimodal Intelligence: Using Images & Barcodes
1:07 Coordinated Workforce: Automated Context Syncing
1:42 Analytics, Traceability, and Enterprise Security

*Q: How does Zoom Virtual Agent interpret context differently than a legacy chatbot?*
*A:* Traditional automated bots rely on scripted menus or rigid keyword paths that quickly stall when a customer changes topics. Zoom Virtual Agent uses a specialized large language model (LLM) framework that identifies intent dynamically. It handles complex phrasing, shifts in conversational context, and diverse accents without restarting the interaction window.  

*Q: What is multimodal intelligence and how does it speed up ticket resolution?*
*A:* Multimodal capabilities allow the virtual agent to "see" and process visual data alongside voice and text. Instead of forcing a user to manually type out long alphanumeric strings or describe physical damage, the customer can upload a smartphone picture or scan a product barcode. The agent extracts the data, verifies customer records, and initiates the correct internal workflow immediately.  

*Q: How do human customer support agents benefit from this conversational loop?*
*A:* The platform bridges data barriers across your contact center stack so AI and human teams work as a unified unit. As human agents address unique problems, the underlying system documents their methodologies. This converts manual expertise into permanent data inputs, creating a self-correcting system that natively mitigates repeat ticket occurrences.

Learn more: https://www.zoom.com/en/products/virtual-agent/

snippet.title: Webinar: How AI Is Used in Astronaut Training and Space Exploration
snippet.description:
Artificial intelligence is helping future astronauts prepare for space missions through simulations, realistic training scenarios, data analysis, and educational tools that support scientific discovery. In this video, Alyssa Carson, a PhD candidate researching life on Mars, shares her journey from aspiring astronaut to space science researcher and explains how AI is changing the way students, researchers, and astronaut candidates learn, train, and solve problems. This video is relevant for students, educators, space science audiences, STEM programs, and anyone interested in AI, astronaut training, Mars research, and the future of exploration.

0:00 - Introduction: Chasing the Dream of Traveling to Mars
0:46 - How AI is Transforming Space Science and Data Analysis
1:25 - Redefining Education: Utilizing AI for Student Learning
1:50 - Turning Your Big Dreams into Reality with AI & Outro

How can AI help students pursue big dreams and future careers?
AI can help students learn, create, experiment, and explore career paths faster. It can support ideas in science, business, art, invention, and other fields by helping students build skills and turn dreams into real projects.

How is AI used in space science and Mars exploration?
AI helps scientists analyze large amounts of data, build models of places humans have not explored yet, search for signs of life, and prepare for future space missions before leaving Earth.

snippet.title: Webinar: AI as a Learning Tool, Not a Shortcut for Students
snippet.description:
In this Zoom Events session from Zoom Ahead: AI for Tomorrow’s Leaders, elementary student Brooke shares how students can use artificial intelligence as a learning tool rather than a shortcut. The video explores how AI can help students ask better questions, understand difficult concepts, practice problem-solving, strengthen study habits, and build critical thinking skills while maintaining academic integrity.

0:00 - Introduction: From Biology Teacher to Coding & AI
0:38 - Embracing Change: New Careers in the AI Era
1:16 - Using AI as a Creative Partner for Team Innovation
1:44 - Accelerating Code: The Evolving Role of Development
2:02 - Critical Thinking: Training Your Brain, Not Outsourcing It
2:31 - Three Vital Rules for Ethical and Responsible AI Use
3:32 - Finding Your Launchpad & Outro

How can students use AI to create and learn?
Students can use AI as a creative partner to build games, apps, projects, and solutions for real-world problems. AI can help them test ideas faster, but they still need curiosity, clear thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Why is it important to use AI responsibly?
AI can be wrong, biased, or incomplete, so human judgment needs to lead. Students should use AI as a launchpad, be honest about what they created, and make sure their work helps people in a meaningful way.

snippet.title: Zoom Webinars & Events Analytics: How to Measure Event Performance
snippet.description:
Learn how to use Zoom Events and Zoom Webinars Plus analytics to measure event performance, attendee behavior, audience engagement, and revenue follow-up opportunities.
This analytics overview explains how event teams can track registration, attendance, session participation, questions, poll responses, and high-intent engagement signals to improve future webinars and prioritize sales outreach.

0:57 - Company Profiles: Account-Level Intent Signals
1:22 - Session Drilldown: Recurring Webinar Audits
1:36 - Q&A Insights: Mapping Audience Pain Points
1:55 - Flexible Exports: BI Tool & CRM Integration
2:05 - Conclusion: Turning Data into Sales Action

*What We Cover Inside:*

• *Cross-Event Analytics:* View macro program performance, funnel conversion curves, and audience drop-off points in one screen.

• *Attendee Insights:* Track individual interaction profiles detailing sessions joined, contents watched, and questions asked.

• *Company Profiles:* Aggregate collective engagement at the account level to easily score target corporate buying teams.

• *Session Drilldown:* Quickly audit individual recurring office hours or demo performance grids via a centralized slide panel.

• *Q&A Insights:* Catalog specific audience interests by mapping out every submitted question and its resolution status.

• *Flexible Data Exports:* Seamlessly push your charts, lead metrics, and tables directly into CSV files, CRMs, or BI engines.

snippet.title: Zoom Video Management: Unify, Upload, and Share Content
snippet.description:
Discover how to transform scattered recordings into an organized, discoverable video hub using Zoom Video Management. This walk-through demonstrates how your existing Zoom meetings and webinars flow automatically into a centralized depository, eliminating the costly friction of shifting assets across multiple third-party hosting platforms.

In this product feature tour, learn how built-in AI tools instantly make video content more useful by automatically generating navigational chapters, extracting high-yield summaries, and embedding search tools right into your daily learning ecosystems.

0:00 - The Operational Cost of Scattered Video Content
0:12 - Introduction to Zoom Video Management Workflows
0:23 - Creating and Uploading Content with Zoom Clips
0:28 - Building Enterprise Collections: From Onboarding to All Hands
0:37 - Higher Education Publishing & Native LMS Integrations
0:46 - Leveraging AI-Generated Chapters and Summaries
0:58 - Conclusion: Get More from Every Video Asset

Q: What is Zoom Video Management?
A: Zoom Video Management is an integrated enterprise Video CMS that allows organizations to automatically collect, organize, and promote recorded content in a single hub. It syncs with standard cloud recordings and custom uploads to build secure internal video libraries.

Q: How does AI improve video asset discoverability?
A: Built-in AI models automatically parse the audio-visual stream to generate interactive chapters, structural textual summaries, and deep search filters. This allows users to pinpoint and jump directly to specific passages within a lengthy video file.

Learn more: https://www.zoom.com/en/products/video-management/

snippet.title: Zoom Webinars & Events: 2025 Product Recap and Innovation Highlights
snippet.description:
Revisit a historic chapter of virtual connection, prestige technical validation, and platform innovation! Look back at how *Zoom Webinars* and *Zoom Events* spent the past year completely re-engineering how organizations inspire, engage, and scale global audiences (0:00).

*Key Milestones & Platform Innovations Detailed Inside:*

• *Emmy-Winning Infrastructure:* Learn about the Television Academy honoring Zoom with an Engineering, Science, and Technology Emmy Award for its broadcast contribution ecosystem, giving you the exact same production reliability used by global television networks (0:16).

• *Streamlined Event Frameworks:* Walk through the completely redesigned workspace sidebar that optimizes scheduling workflows while retaining deep access to advanced webinar parameters (0:48).

• *Ubiquitous AI Workflows:* See how native *AI Companion* tools pull session details straight from your text files during planning loops, and discover the live-session "What did I miss?" feature built for late-arriving attendees (1:04).

• *Automated Simulated-Live Formats:* Explore low-stress presentation mechanics like delayed starts, automatic viewer polling pipelines, and seamless simulated-live transitions for pre-recorded media elements (1:23).

• *Cloud Production Switcher Upgrade:* Dive into the historic shift of *Zoom Production Studio* entirely to the cloud, unlocking flawless layout scene stability and dependable broadcast streaming without demanding local hardware overhead (1:31).

• *On-Demand Content Hubs:* Turn static recordings into months of ongoing marketing loops. Centralize town halls, lectures, and event summaries in a discoverable repository, and use generative AI to instantly craft post-event blogs and recaps (1:49).

• *Overhauled Event Analytics:* Leverage deep-dive performance metric dashboards to gain clear, actionable data insights across your entire organizational calendar grid (2:14).

From hosting flagship global gather spaces like *Zoomtopia 2025* and the inaugural *Zoom Event Summit* (2:24), to empowering real-world missions across healthcare, technology, and international non-profits (2:55), discover how professional video production has officially become accessible to teams of any size.

Elevate your presentation metrics, leverage next-generation AI, and start building unforgettable digital spaces today!

snippet.title: How to Set Up a Zoom Phone Virtual Agent: Complete AI Auto-Receptionist Guide
snippet.description:
Learn how to set up Zoom Phone AI Concierge to help answer business calls, route customer inquiries, and support receptionist-style phone workflows. This tutorial explains how small businesses, operators, IT teams, and customer-facing teams can use an AI-powered phone assistant to streamline call handling, improve caller experiences, and route inquiries to the right team more efficiently.

0:00 - Lean Team Challenges: Eliminating Missed B2B & Local Customer Calls
0:22 - Zoom Virtual Agent Concierge: Retail Store Hardware Blueprint
0:45 - AI Persona Configuration: Customizing Retail Templates & Voice Greetings
1:11 - Knowledge Base Setup: Injecting Local Store FAQs & Real-Time Inventory
1:20 - Automated Booking Skills: Mapping Zoom Scheduler URLs via Slash Commands
1:49 - Live Call Transfers: Routing AI Exceptions to Zoom Phone Customer Service Queues
2:13 - Publishing the Voice Bot & Linking to Zoom Phone Auto-Receptionist Nodes
2:43 - Customer Experience Demo: After-Hours Automated Inventory Checking
3:23 - Live Call Simulation: AI Store Assistant Handling Tool Rental Bookings
5:57 - Closing ROI: Meeting Local Customer Expectations Without Increasing Staff Overhead

How do Knowledge Libraries differ from "Skills" within Zoom Virtual Agent? (1:11)
Knowledge Libraries hold static data assets (like local shop hours or inventory lists) used by the AI to answer direct customer questions. Skills allow the virtual agent to execute smart, multi-step actions, such as using slash commands to fetch external Zoom Scheduler calendar links or dynamically routing calls to alternative phone lines.

Can Zoom's AI concierge identify exact retail shelf locations for callers? (3:42)
Yes. If your real-time inventory sheet includes location mapping, the virtual voice assistant will seamlessly cross-reference the customer's request and provide item availability, current counts, and the exact aisle and bay location (e.g., Aisle 24, Bay 2).

How do you connect a published Zoom Virtual Agent to a live business phone number? (2:17)
Inside your main Zoom Phone admin dashboard, go to the Auto Receptionist section and click the Virtual Agent tab. Add a new instance, connect it to your specific operating site, name your bot, select the virtual agent script you published, and assign your public-facing telephone number to go live.

Learn more: https://www.zoom.com/en/products/voip-phone/features/ai-receptionist/

snippet.description:
Learn how to integrate Zoom Contact Center with Salesforce Service Cloud Voice to centralize voice interactions, agent workflows, telephony data, and customer records. This video explains how the integration helps agents work from a unified interface, access relevant CRM information, and support customer service workflows more efficiently inside Salesforce Service Cloud.

0:05 - Introduction: Zoom Integration with Salesforce Service Cloud Voice
0:13 - Agent Experience & Call Management Interface
0:39 - Supervisor Tools & Real-Time Call Monitoring

What is the Zoom integration with Salesforce Service Cloud Voice?
The integration lets agents manage Zoom-powered phone calls directly inside Salesforce Service Cloud Voice, alongside Salesforce digital channels. It supports real-time transcription, customer data integration, and call controls within the Salesforce service console.

How does the Zoom Salesforce Service Cloud Voice integration help agents and supervisors?
Agents can answer, transfer, mute, hold, and end calls without leaving the omni-channel interface. Supervisors can monitor voice calls, flag calls for review, send agents real-time text notes, and remotely adjust agent status.

snippet.title: Zoom Sessions Rebranded! Meet Zoom Webinars Plus (New Features & Updates)
snippet.description:
Big changes are landing on the platform this month! 

In this comprehensive walkthrough, we break down a massive list of new releases designed to elevate your streaming quality, automate post-show marketing, and simplify enterprise workflows.

Inside this product update:

- *Rebranding to Zoom Webinars Plus:* Say goodbye to "Zoom Sessions"—the licensing has evolved into Zoom Webinars Plus to clearly communicate the premium capabilities included in your package, like Virtual Backstage and Production Studio.

- *Cloud-Rendered Production Studio:* No more worrying about a host's local hardware or fluctuating internet connections. The entire rendering architecture has moved to the cloud, meaning if a host drops, the broadcast rolls on smoothly while another teammate takes control.

- *Production Studio Video Scenes:* The top-requested feature is finally here! You can now upload large video assets (up to 2 hours or 4GB) natively into your scenes, complete with custom playback behaviors and an "automatically advance" feature to eliminate live miscues.

- *Automatic AI Content Generation:* Let Zoom AI Companion do the heavy lifting. Toggle on auto-creation in your backend settings, and the platform will instantly extract key takeaways, draft blog posts, compile follow-up emails, and clip out viral video snippets the exact moment your webinar concludes.

- *Simulive Host Early Join:* Your production team no longer has to wait in limbo. Hosts and panelists can now hop into the backstage space early to set up Q&A queues, coordinate graphics, and manage delayed stream counts before pre-recorded broadcasts go live.

- *Full Account Admin Rights:* IT administrators now possess view and edit access over nearly every interface of the Zoom Webinars or Events hub—empowering them to adjust metadata, assign co-editors, change layouts, and pull deep hub analytics on demand.

Don't forget to secure your virtual seat for Zoomtopia to see where AI-powered work is headed next! For a full technical breakdown of every patch note this month, visit support.zoom.com.

snippet.title: ZoomISO Product Walkthrough | extract isolated HD video and audio feeds from Zoom
snippet.description:
Learn how to extract isolated Zoom video and audio feeds for broadcast using ZoomISO and professional production workflows. This production overview explains how broadcast engineers and event producers can separate participant cameras, screen shares, language interpretation channels, and audio sources, then route clean feeds into OBS, NDI, SDI, SRT, Dante Virtual Soundcard, hardware switchers, and hybrid event production environments.

0:00 — What is Zoom ISO? Isolated Broadcast Feeds Explained
0:47 — Launching Zoom ISO & Session Joining Methods
1:19 — The HD Pothole: Enabling 1080p Feeds in the Web Portal
1:56 — Joining a Live Webinar from the Events Platform Backstage
2:35 — Configuring Video Outputs: Bitrate & Resolution Constraints
3:31 — Mapping Feeds: Participant Video, Active Speakers, & Screen Shares
4:05 — Output Protocols: NDI, SRT, Siphon, & SDI DeckLink Cards
5:02 — Activating the Capture Engine & Verification via NDI Monitor
6:06 — Live Production Integration: Bringing Feeds into OBS Studio
6:35 — Advanced Automation: Bitfocus Companion & Stream Deck Control
7:18 — Multi-Channel Audio Routing & Dante Virtual Soundcard
7:54 — Extracting Isolated Language Interpretation Audio Channels
8:50 — Managing Participants, Zoom OSC, & Troubleshooting Error Logs
9:11 — Advanced Use Cases: Hybrid Events & Post-Production ISO Recording

💡 KEY TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHTS
- Mandatory Portal HD Preparation: A frequent integration pitfall is failing to prepare the parent container. Clean 1080p feeds (typically pulling 4 to 6 Mbps each) will not transfer downstream unless Group HD and broadcast permissions are explicitly activated ahead of time inside the Zoom account web or events dashboard portal.
- Fail-Safe Resource Optimization: Zoom ISO implements hardware guardrails to prevent mid-event host execution crashes. The platform limits system resources to 80% total utilization or a strict 100 Mbps bandwidth ceiling, altering layout quality gracefully if conditions deteriorate.
- Dynamic Video Loss Protocols: Event producers can configure deterministic behaviors if a remote speaker drops their video line or suffers a camera failure. The system lets you quickly choose between dropping to a clean black field, rendering a static broadcast test card, or reflecting a company logo seamlessly.
- Isolating Language Interpretation Layers: Zoom ISO allows producers to programmatically parse and separate real-time interpretation audio tracks (such as isolated English, Spanish, or Japanese translators). This makes it incredibly straightforward to power secondary, localized alternative live streams with perfect audio separation.
- Massive Audio Expansion via Dante: For physical console environments, pairing Zoom ISO with a Dante Virtual Soundcard unlocks an expansive 64 channels of discrete, multi-channel audio routing matrix capability, matching your physical audio boards line-for-line.

Learn more on Zoom: https://devforum.zoom.us/t/accessing-audio-stream-of-a-live-meeting-without-recording/101889

You can create a Zoom Virtual Agent in AI Studio by adding a knowledge base, naming the agent, writing guidance and a greeting, choosing a voice, connecting the knowledge source, and creating the agent.

Zoom AI Studio lets you connect knowledge sources like Zoom Docs, PDFs, web sync, or integrations such as Google Drive, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and SharePoint. The virtual agent uses that knowledge to answer customer questions and guide conversations.
